description.text: The third expansion of the DPt series, released on 6 March 2009. It is set in the Battle Frontier, the facility of many kinds of battle that opens after the Hall of Fame in Pokémon Platinum, and brings the SP Pokémon of its Frontier Brains, marked FB, such as Blaziken FB and Staraptor FB. Champions' Pokémon join them with a C mark, among them Rayquaza C LV.X. The cards are numbered to 100. In English it became Supreme Victors in August 2009.
